verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a framework for building voice agents, and a built-in assistant in its CLI, docs, or Cloud dashboard is a fair thing to ask about, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The context-hub MCP index and the generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files serve external coding agents, and the agents users build are framework output. Neither counts as a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
